get the ball rolling
Idiom · neutral–informal

Let's order pizza and get the ball rolling on this party.
column2:
khởi động, bắt đầu một việc
to start an activity or process so that it continues

Ngữ pháp: get + the ball + rolling (V-ing làm bổ ngữ cho tân ngữ: làm cho quả bóng lăn). Hay đi với: get the ball rolling on + N / by + V-ing. Biến thể: start / set the ball rolling (Anh-Anh hay dùng set).
Kết hợp: get the ball rolling on the project · let's get the ball rolling · get the ball rolling by + V-ing
Ví dụ:
• Let's order pizza and get the ball rolling on this party.
• I'll send out the kickoff email to get the ball rolling on the test plan.
• To get the ball rolling, the government could offer small grants to start-ups.
Lỗi hay mắc: Nói “get the ball roll” (thiếu -ing) hoặc “make the ball rolling”. Đúng: get the ball rolling.

column1:
be on the same page
Idiom · neutral

Before we book anything, let's make sure we're on the same page about the budget.
column2:
cùng hiểu một vấn đề, thống nhất
to agree or share the same understanding

Ngữ pháp: be + on the same page (+ about/with + N). Dùng “on” vì hình ảnh mọi người cùng mở đến một trang sách. Hay ở dạng câu hỏi xác nhận: Are we on the same page?
Kết hợp: make sure we're on the same page · get everyone on the same page · on the same page about the scope
Ví dụ:
• Before we book anything, let's make sure we're on the same page about the budget.
• Can we sync quickly so dev and QA are on the same page about the acceptance criteria?
• Parents and teachers need to be on the same page if children are to learn good habits.
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng “in the same page” (sai giới từ).

column1:
a blessing in disguise
Idiom · neutral

Missing that flight was a blessing in disguise — I met my wife at the airport.
column2:
trong cái rủi có cái may
something that seems bad at first but turns out to be good

Ngữ pháp: be + a blessing in disguise. Thường đi với: turn out to be / prove to be a blessing in disguise. “in disguise” = được ngụy trang.
Kết hợp: turn out to be a blessing in disguise · prove a blessing in disguise
Ví dụ:
• Missing that flight was a blessing in disguise — I met my wife at the airport.
• Losing that client turned out to be a blessing in disguise; we finally fixed our process.
• Failing my first IELTS test was a blessing in disguise because it made me practise speaking every day.
Lỗi hay mắc: Thiếu mạo từ “a” hoặc nói “blessing in disguised”.

column1:
the tip of the iceberg
Idiom · neutral

The broken window is just the tip of the iceberg — the whole house needs work.
column2:
phần nổi của tảng băng
a small, visible part of a much bigger problem

Ngữ pháp: be + (only/just) the tip of the iceberg. Luôn có “the … the”.
Kết hợp: just the tip of the iceberg · only the tip of the iceberg
Ví dụ:
• The broken window is just the tip of the iceberg — the whole house needs work.
• These three failing tests are only the tip of the iceberg; the module has no coverage at all.
• Reported cases of cyberbullying are probably just the tip of the iceberg.
Lỗi hay mắc: Bỏ mạo từ: “tip of iceberg”.

column1:
bite the bullet
Idiom · informal–neutral

I finally bit the bullet and went to the dentist.
column2:
cắn răng làm việc khó / khó chịu
to force yourself to do something unpleasant that you have been avoiding

Ngữ pháp: bite (bit, bitten) the bullet (and + V). Ví dụ: bite the bullet and refactor.
Kết hợp: bite the bullet and + V · finally bit the bullet
Ví dụ:
• I finally bit the bullet and went to the dentist.
• We need to bite the bullet and rewrite the flaky test suite.
• Sometimes governments have to bite the bullet and raise taxes.
Lỗi hay mắc: Hiểu nhầm là “nói lời cay nghiệt”.

column1:
go the extra mile
Idiom · neutral

The hotel staff really went the extra mile for us.
column2:
làm nhiều hơn mức được yêu cầu
to make more effort than is expected

Ngữ pháp: go (went, gone) the extra mile (for sb / to + V).
Kết hợp: go the extra mile for customers · be willing to go the extra mile
Ví dụ:
• The hotel staff really went the extra mile for us.
• She always goes the extra mile — she even documented edge cases nobody asked for.
• Employees who feel valued are more willing to go the extra mile.
Lỗi hay mắc: “go an extra mile” (nên dùng the); “go extra miles”.

column1:
play devil's advocate
Idiom · neutral

I agree, but let me play devil's advocate: what if it rains?
column2:
cố tình đứng phía phản biện
to argue the opposite view to test an idea

Ngữ pháp: play devil's advocate (không có “the” trước devil's). Mẫu hay dùng: Let me play devil's advocate (for a second).
Kết hợp: let me play devil's advocate · just playing devil's advocate
Ví dụ:
• I agree, but let me play devil's advocate: what if it rains?
• Just to play devil's advocate — what happens if the API is down during the release?
• Playing devil's advocate, one could argue that exams do motivate students.
Lỗi hay mắc: “play the devil advocate”, “play devil advocate” (thiếu 's).

column1:
easier said than done
Idiom · neutral

“Just stop worrying.” “That's easier said than done.”
column2:
nói thì dễ, làm mới khó
it is harder to do than to talk about

Ngữ pháp: That's / It's easier said than done. Cấu trúc so sánh hơn + bị động rút gọn (said / done).
Kết hợp: that's easier said than done
Ví dụ:
• “Just stop worrying.” “That's easier said than done.”
• Reducing test execution time is easier said than done with a shared database.
• Changing eating habits is easier said than done for busy workers.
Lỗi hay mắc: “more easy said than done”.

column1:
the elephant in the room
Idiom · neutral

Okay, let's talk about the elephant in the room: who's paying for this?
column2:
vấn đề ai cũng thấy nhưng né không nói
an obvious problem that people avoid talking about

Ngữ pháp: address / ignore / talk about + the elephant in the room.
Kết hợp: address the elephant in the room · ignore the elephant in the room
Ví dụ:
• Okay, let's talk about the elephant in the room: who's paying for this?
• The elephant in the room is that we have no automated regression tests.
• Inequality is often the elephant in the room in debates about education.
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng “an elephant in the room”.

column1:
back to square one
Idiom · informal–neutral

The landlord said no, so we're back to square one with the apartment hunt.
column2:
quay lại vạch xuất phát
back to the beginning after failing

Ngữ pháp: be back to square one / go back to square one.
Kết hợp: we're back to square one · go back to square one
Ví dụ:
• The landlord said no, so we're back to square one with the apartment hunt.
• The fix didn't work, so we're back to square one on this bug.
• If the policy fails, the government will be back to square one.
Lỗi hay mắc: “back to the square one”.

column1:
cut corners
Idiom · neutral

Don't cut corners when you're fixing the brakes.
column2:
làm ẩu, đốt cháy giai đoạn để tiết kiệm
to do something cheaply or quickly by skipping steps

Ngữ pháp: cut corners (on + N). Không tách: không nói “cut the corners”.
Kết hợp: cut corners on safety · cut corners on testing
Ví dụ:
• Don't cut corners when you're fixing the brakes.
• If we cut corners on testing, we'll pay for it in production.
• Companies that cut corners on safety put workers at risk.
Lỗi hay mắc: “cut the corner” (số ít + the mang nghĩa đen: đi tắt góc đường).

column1:
hit the nail on the head
Idiom · neutral

You've hit the nail on the head — he's just jealous.
column2:
nói trúng phóc
to describe exactly what is causing a problem

Ngữ pháp: hit (hit, hit) the nail on the head. Hay dùng ở hiện tại hoàn thành: You've hit the nail on the head.
Kết hợp: you've hit the nail on the head · really hit the nail on the head
Ví dụ:
• You've hit the nail on the head — he's just jealous.
• I think Linh hit the nail on the head: the test data is the real problem.
• The report hits the nail on the head when it blames poor planning.
Lỗi hay mắc: “hit the nail in the head”.

column1:
figure out
Phrasal Verb · neutral–informal

I can't figure out how to turn this thing off.
column2:
tìm ra, hiểu ra (sau khi suy nghĩ)
to understand or solve something by thinking

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ, TÁCH ĐƯỢC: figure out the problem / figure the problem out / figure it out (đại từ BẮT BUỘC ở giữa). Hay đi với từ để hỏi: figure out how/why/what + clause. “out” = làm cho lộ ra, ra kết quả.
Kết hợp: figure out how to + V · figure out why… · figure it out · figure out a solution
Ví dụ:
• I can't figure out how to turn this thing off.
• Let me figure out why the test only fails on Chrome.
• Many teenagers are still trying to figure out what they want to do in life.
Lỗi hay mắc: “figure out it” (đại từ phải đứng giữa: figure it out). Nhầm với find out (xem phần so sánh).

column1:
find out
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I just found out that my neighbor is a famous chef.
column2:
phát hiện, biết được (thông tin)
to get information or learn a fact

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại hoặc nội động từ. Tách được với danh từ: find out the truth / find the truth out; với đại từ: find it out (ít dùng — người Mỹ hay nói find out about it). find out about + N, find out that/whether/what…
Kết hợp: find out the truth · find out about… · find out whether… · find out the hard way
Ví dụ:
• I just found out that my neighbor is a famous chef.
• Can you find out which build introduced the regression?
• Many people only find out about scholarships when it's too late.
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng find out cho việc giải bài toán (“find out the answer to the math problem” — nên dùng figure out / work out).

column1:
look up
Phrasal Verb · neutral

If you don't know the word, look it up.
column2:
tra cứu (từ điển, mạng)
to search for information in a book, list or online

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ, TÁCH ĐƯỢC: look up a word / look a word up / look it up. Nghĩa khác: things are looking up (đang khá lên — nội động từ).
Kết hợp: look up a word · look it up online · look up someone's number
Ví dụ:
• If you don't know the word, look it up.
• Can you look up the error code in the docs?
• I look up unfamiliar collocations instead of guessing.
Lỗi hay mắc: “look up it”; dùng look up cho việc điều tra sự cố (nên dùng look into).

column1:
bring up
Phrasal Verb · neutral

Please don't bring up his ex at dinner.
column2:
nêu ra, nhắc tới (chủ đề); nuôi nấng
to mention a subject; to raise a child

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ, TÁCH ĐƯỢC: bring up the issue / bring the issue up / bring it up. Bị động hay gặp: I was brought up in Hue (tôi được nuôi lớn ở Huế). “up” = đưa lên bề mặt.
Kết hợp: bring up a concern · bring up the subject · bring it up in the meeting · be brought up by
Ví dụ:
• Please don't bring up his ex at dinner.
• I'll bring this up in the stand-up tomorrow.
• I was brought up in a small village, so city life was a shock.
Lỗi hay mắc: “bring up it”; nhầm với raise (raise a concern trang trọng hơn).

column1:
point out
Phrasal Verb · neutral

Thanks for pointing that out — I had spinach in my teeth?
column2:
chỉ ra (điều người khác chưa để ý)
to tell someone a fact they may not have noticed

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ, tách được với danh từ ngắn: point out the mistake / point the mistake out. Rất hay đi với that-clause: point out that… (không tách). point sth out to sb.
Kết hợp: point out that… · point out a mistake · as I pointed out earlier · point something out to someone
Ví dụ:
• Thanks for pointing that out — I had spinach in my teeth?
• The reviewer pointed out that the test doesn't cover null input.
• Critics point out that the policy mainly benefits the rich.
Lỗi hay mắc: “point out to me the mistake” nghe nặng; tự nhiên hơn: point the mistake out to me.

column1:
put off
Phrasal Verb · neutral

Stop putting off your taxes — they're due Friday!
column2:
hoãn lại; làm ai mất hứng
to delay something; to make someone dislike something

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ, TÁCH ĐƯỢC: put off the meeting / put the meeting off / put it off. Sau put off dùng V-ing: put off doing sth. Nghĩa 2: sth puts sb off (làm ai ngán).
Kết hợp: put off + V-ing · put it off until… · be put off by
Ví dụ:
• Stop putting off your taxes — they're due Friday!
• Let's put the demo off until the build is stable.
• Many young people are put off by the high cost of university.
Lỗi hay mắc: “put off to do” (đúng: put off doing); nhầm với call off (hủy hẳn).

column1:
call off
Phrasal Verb · neutral

They called off the wedding a week before the big day.
column2:
hủy bỏ (sự kiện, kế hoạch)
to cancel something planned

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ, TÁCH ĐƯỢC: call off the wedding / call the wedding off / call it off. Hay ở bị động: The match was called off.
Kết hợp: call off the meeting · call off a strike · call off the search · be called off due to…
Ví dụ:
• They called off the wedding a week before the big day.
• The release was called off because of a critical security bug.
• The festival was called off due to heavy rain.
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng call off với nghĩa “gọi điện tắt máy”.

column1:
deal with
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I'll deal with the dishes later.
column2:
xử lý, giải quyết; đối mặt; giao dịch với
to take action to solve a problem; to handle

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ, KHÔNG TÁCH: deal with it (không nói “deal it with”). Quá khứ: dealt. Bị động: be dealt with.
Kết hợp: deal with a problem · deal with customers · deal with stress · be dealt with promptly
Ví dụ:
• I'll deal with the dishes later.
• Can you deal with this ticket? It's blocking the release.
• Schools must deal with bullying more effectively.
Lỗi hay mắc: “deal the problem” (thiếu with); “dealed”.

column1:
cope with
Phrasal Verb · neutral

How do you cope with three kids and a full-time job?
column2:
đương đầu, xoay xở được (với khó khăn)
to manage successfully in a difficult situation

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ không tách, hoặc nội động từ (I can't cope!). cope with + N/V-ing.
Kết hợp: cope with stress · cope with pressure · cope with the workload · struggle to cope
Ví dụ:
• How do you cope with three kids and a full-time job?
• The server couldn't cope with the traffic spike.
• Many students struggle to cope with exam pressure.
Lỗi hay mắc: “cope up with” (thừa up — lỗi rất phổ biến của người châu Á).

column1:
come across
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I came across some old photos while cleaning.
column2:
tình cờ thấy/gặp; tạo ấn tượng (come across as)
to find or meet by chance; to seem to be

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ KHÔNG TÁCH: come across an article / come across it. Nghĩa 2 (nội động từ): come across as + adj/N (He comes across as arrogant).
Kết hợp: come across an article · come across a bug · come across as rude
Ví dụ:
• I came across some old photos while cleaning.
• Have you ever come across this error before?
• He can come across as arrogant, but he's actually shy.
Lỗi hay mắc: “come across with” hoặc tách “come it across”.

column1:
run into
Phrasal Verb · neutral–informal

Guess who I ran into at the mall? Our old math teacher!
column2:
tình cờ gặp (người); gặp phải (rắc rối)
to meet someone by chance; to experience a problem

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ KHÔNG TÁCH: run into an old friend / run into problems. Quá khứ: ran.
Kết hợp: run into an old friend · run into problems · run into trouble · run into an issue with
Ví dụ:
• Guess who I ran into at the mall? Our old math teacher!
• We ran into an issue with the staging database last night.
• Start-ups often run into cash-flow problems in their first year.
Lỗi hay mắc: “run in to”; “run into with”.

column1:
give up
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I gave up coffee for a month — worst month ever.
column2:
từ bỏ; bỏ (thói quen)
to stop trying; to stop doing a habit

Ngữ pháp: Nội động từ (Don't give up!) hoặc ngoại động từ tách được (give up smoking / give it up). give up + V-ing.
Kết hợp: give up smoking · never give up · give up on someone · give up hope
Ví dụ:
• I gave up coffee for a month — worst month ever.
• Don't give up on automation just because the first attempt was flaky.
• Many people give up learning a language after a few months.
Lỗi hay mắc: “give up to smoke” (đúng: give up smoking); nhầm với give in.

column1:
give in
Phrasal Verb · neutral

The kids kept begging, so I finally gave in and bought the puppy.
column2:
chịu thua, nhượng bộ
to finally agree after resisting; to surrender

Ngữ pháp: Nội động từ: give in (to sb/sth). Không có tân ngữ trực tiếp. Nghĩa Anh-Anh khác: give in homework = nộp bài.
Kết hợp: give in to pressure · give in to temptation · finally gave in
Ví dụ:
• The kids kept begging, so I finally gave in and bought the puppy.
• We shouldn't give in to pressure to skip regression testing.
• Governments should not give in to the demands of terrorists.
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng give in với nghĩa bỏ cuộc một mình (“I gave in learning English”) — nên dùng give up.

column1:
work out
Phrasal Verb · neutral

Don't worry, it'll all work out.
column2:
tìm ra; thành công/ổn; tập thể dục
to find a solution; to end well; to exercise

Ngữ pháp: (1) Ngoại động từ tách được: work out a plan / work it out. (2) Nội động từ: Things will work out. (3) Nội động từ: I work out at the gym.
Kết hợp: work out a solution · it'll all work out · things didn't work out · work out the cost
Ví dụ:
• Don't worry, it'll all work out.
• We need to work out how to run these tests in parallel.
• Relationships don't always work out, and that's okay.
Lỗi hay mắc: “work out it”; quên nghĩa “thành công/ổn”.

column1:
sort out
Phrasal Verb · neutral–informal

You two need to sit down and sort this out.
column2:
giải quyết, thu xếp, dọn dẹp cho gọn
to deal with a problem or organize something

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ TÁCH ĐƯỢC: sort out the problem / sort it out. Hay dùng ở dạng get sth sorted (out).
Kết hợp: sort out a problem · sort it out · get it sorted · sort out the paperwork
Ví dụ:
• You two need to sit down and sort this out.
• I'll sort out the access issue with IT this afternoon.
• The government needs to sort out the housing crisis.
Lỗi hay mắc: “sort out with the problem” (thừa with).

column1:
set up
Phrasal Verb · neutral

Can you help me set up my new phone?
column2:
thiết lập, cài đặt, dựng; sắp đặt; gài bẫy
to arrange, establish or prepare something

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ TÁCH ĐƯỢC: set up a meeting / set it up. Danh từ viết liền: a setup (hoặc set-up). Bị động: The account is set up.
Kết hợp: set up a meeting · set up a test environment · set up an account · set up a business
Ví dụ:
• Can you help me set up my new phone?
• I'll set up a call with the client for Thursday.
• More young people are setting up their own businesses.
Lỗi hay mắc: Viết danh từ thành “set up” (đúng: setup); “set up it”.

column1:
look into
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I'll look into cheaper flights tonight.
column2:
xem xét, điều tra (một vấn đề)
to investigate or examine something

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ KHÔNG TÁCH: look into the issue / look into it. Bị động: The issue is being looked into.
Kết hợp: look into the issue · look into it · I'll look into this · be looked into
Ví dụ:
• I'll look into cheaper flights tonight.
• Thanks for reporting this — I'll look into it and get back to you.
• The government has promised to look into the causes of the accident.
Lỗi hay mắc: “look it into” (không tách được); dùng look up thay look into.

column1:
carry out
Phrasal Verb · neutral–formal

The landlord finally carried out the repairs.
column2:
tiến hành, thực hiện (kế hoạch, nghiên cứu, kiểm thử)
to do or complete a task, plan or test

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ TÁCH ĐƯỢC (hiếm tách với danh từ dài): carry out tests / carry them out. Bị động rất phổ biến: Tests were carried out on…
Kết hợp: carry out testing · carry out research · carry out a survey · carry out orders
Ví dụ:
• The landlord finally carried out the repairs.
• We carried out load testing on the new endpoint last week.
• More research needs to be carried out before the drug is approved.
Lỗi hay mắc: “carry out with the plan”; dùng cho lời hứa cá nhân (nên dùng follow through / keep).

column1:
follow through (on)
Phrasal Verb · neutral

He says he'll quit smoking, but he never follows through.
column2:
làm đến nơi đến chốn (điều đã hứa/định)
to complete something you started or promised

Ngữ pháp: Nội động từ: follow through (on/with + N). Danh từ: follow-through. Khác follow up (xem lại sau).
Kết hợp: follow through on a promise · follow through with a plan · lack of follow-through
Ví dụ:
• He says he'll quit smoking, but he never follows through.
• If we commit to the deadline, we need to follow through.
• Politicians often fail to follow through on their election promises.
Lỗi hay mắc: Nhầm với follow up.

column1:
take over
Phrasal Verb · neutral

Can you take over driving? I'm exhausted.
column2:
tiếp quản, nắm quyền; thay ca
to take control of something or continue a task from someone else

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ tách được (take over the project / take it over) hoặc nội động từ (Can you take over?). Danh từ: a takeover (thâu tóm công ty).
Kết hợp: take over a project · take over from someone · take over the company · a hostile takeover
Ví dụ:
• Can you take over driving? I'm exhausted.
• Minh will take over the automation framework while I'm on leave.
• Robots may take over many routine jobs.
Lỗi hay mắc: Nhầm với take on.

column1:
take on
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I think you've taken on too much this semester.
column2:
nhận (thêm) việc, đảm nhận; tuyển; đối đầu
to accept work or responsibility; to employ; to compete against

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ TÁCH ĐƯỢC: take on more work / take it on. Hay đi với: take on responsibility/a challenge/staff.
Kết hợp: take on more responsibility · take on a challenge · take on new staff · take on too much
Ví dụ:
• I think you've taken on too much this semester.
• I'd like to take on more responsibility for the CI pipeline.
• Small shops can't take on big supermarkets on price.
Lỗi hay mắc: “take on responsibility of” (đúng: for).

column1:
follow up (on)
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I'm just following up on my message from Monday.
column2:
theo dõi tiếp, hỏi lại, xử lý tiếp
to take further action or check on something later

Ngữ pháp: Nội động từ: follow up (on/with + N): follow up on the ticket, follow up with the client. Ngoại động từ tách được (ít hơn): follow it up. Danh từ/tính từ: a follow-up (email/meeting).
Kết hợp: follow up on a ticket · follow up with the client · a follow-up email · just following up
Ví dụ:
• I'm just following up on my message from Monday.
• Can you follow up with the vendor about the license?
• Doctors should follow up with patients after surgery.
Lỗi hay mắc: Viết danh từ không gạch nối (follow-up); nhầm với follow through.

column1:
push back
Phrasal Verb · neutral–informal

Can we push dinner back to eight?
column2:
dời lại (lịch); phản bác, không đồng ý
to delay to a later time; to resist or argue against

Ngữ pháp: (1) Ngoại động từ tách được: push back the deadline / push it back (to Friday). (2) Nội động từ: push back on + N (phản đối). Danh từ: pushback.
Kết hợp: push back the deadline · push the release back a week · push back on a requirement · get pushback from
Ví dụ:
• Can we push dinner back to eight?
• We had to push back the release by a week.
• It's fine to push back on unrealistic deadlines if you explain why.
Lỗi hay mắc: Hiểu push back = đẩy sớm lên (sai: push back = dời muộn hơn; dời sớm = move up / bring forward).

column1:
narrow down
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I've narrowed it down to two dresses.
column2:
thu hẹp (lựa chọn, phạm vi)
to reduce the number of possibilities

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ TÁCH ĐƯỢC: narrow down the options / narrow it down (to + N).
Kết hợp: narrow down the options · narrow it down to two · narrow down the cause · narrow down the search
Ví dụ:
• I've narrowed it down to two dresses.
• We've narrowed the problem down to the login service.
• Students should narrow down their essay topic before researching.
Lỗi hay mắc: “narrow down to two options” khi thiếu tân ngữ — nên: narrow it down to two.

column1:
roll out (a feature)
Phrasal Verb · neutral (tech/business)

The bank is rolling out a new app next month.
column2:
triển khai, phát hành (dần) tính năng
to release a product or feature, often gradually

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ tách được: roll out the update / roll it out (to users). Danh từ: a rollout (staged/phased rollout). Chuẩn trong công nghệ, không phải lóng.
Kết hợp: roll out a feature · roll out to 10% of users · a staged rollout · roll back (hoàn tác)
Ví dụ:
• The bank is rolling out a new app next month.
• We'll roll out the new checkout flow to 10% of users first.
• The government rolled out the vaccine programme nationwide.
Lỗi hay mắc: Nhầm với roll back (hoàn tác bản phát hành).

column1:
spin up (a server)
Phrasal Verb · technical jargon / informal workplace

Can you spin up a quick demo for the client?
column2:
khởi tạo nhanh (máy chủ, môi trường, container)
to quickly create and start a server or environment

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ tách được: spin up a container / spin it up. Đây là technical jargon — tránh trong văn viết IELTS.
Kết hợp: spin up a server · spin up a test environment · spin up containers · spin down (tắt)
Ví dụ:
• Can you spin up a quick demo for the client?
• The pipeline spins up a fresh Docker container for every test run.
• (Không dùng trong IELTS — thay bằng: set up / create.)
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng trong văn viết trang trọng/IELTS.

column1:
track down (a bug)
Phrasal Verb · neutral

I finally tracked down my old roommate on Facebook.
column2:
lần ra, truy tìm (sau khi tìm kỹ)
to find something after a long search

Ngữ pháp: Ngoại động từ TÁCH ĐƯỢC: track down the bug / track it down. “down” = tới tận nơi, đến cùng.
Kết hợp: track down a bug · track down the root cause · track someone down
Ví dụ:
• I finally tracked down my old roommate on Facebook.
• It took two days to track down the memory leak.
• Police used CCTV to track down the suspects.
Lỗi hay mắc: “track the bug” (thiếu down — nghĩa thành “theo dõi”).

column1:
raise a concern
Collocation · neutral–formal

Several parents raised concerns about the new school bus route.
column2:
nêu lên một mối lo ngại
to mention a worry formally

Ngữ pháp: raise + a concern / concerns (about/over + N). raise (ngoại động từ: nâng/nêu) ≠ rise (nội động từ). Bị động: Concerns have been raised about…
Kết hợp: raise concerns about security · raise a concern with the team · concerns were raised over…
Ví dụ:
• Several parents raised concerns about the new school bus route.
• I'd like to raise a concern about test coverage before we sign off.
• Experts have raised concerns about the impact of AI on jobs.
Lỗi hay mắc: “rise a concern” (sai: rise là nội động từ); “raise a concern on” (tự nhiên hơn: about).

column1:
meet a deadline
Collocation · neutral

I stayed up all night to meet the deadline.
column2:
kịp hạn chót
to finish something by the agreed time

Ngữ pháp: meet / miss a deadline. Không dùng “catch/reach a deadline”. Hay có: tight deadline, meet the deadline for + N.
Kết hợp: meet a tight deadline · miss the deadline · work to a deadline · deadline for submission
Ví dụ:
• I stayed up all night to meet the deadline.
• We'll only meet the deadline if we cut the scope.
• Students who cannot meet deadlines often suffer from stress.
Lỗi hay mắc: “catch the deadline”, “reach the deadline” (dịch từ tiếng Việt “kịp”).

column1:
reach a consensus
Collocation · neutral–formal

We couldn't reach a consensus on where to eat, so we flipped a coin.
column2:
đạt được đồng thuận
to come to general agreement

Ngữ pháp: reach / come to / build a consensus (on/about + N). “consensus” đã có nghĩa đồng thuận chung → tránh “general consensus of opinion” (thừa).
Kết hợp: reach a consensus on · build consensus · there is a growing consensus that
Ví dụ:
• We couldn't reach a consensus on where to eat, so we flipped a coin.
• After two meetings, the team reached a consensus on the tech stack.
• There is a growing consensus that climate change requires urgent action.
Lỗi hay mắc: “reach to a consensus”; viết sai “concensus”.

column1:
address an issue
Collocation · formal

We need to address the noise issue with our neighbors.
column2:
giải quyết / xử lý một vấn đề
to start dealing with a problem

Ngữ pháp: address (ngoại động từ, KHÔNG có giới từ) + the issue/problem/concern. Sai: address to the issue.
Kết hợp: address the issue of · address concerns · address the root cause · fail to address
Ví dụ:
• We need to address the noise issue with our neighbors.
• This patch addresses the issue reported in ticket 214.
• Governments must address the issue of rising housing costs.
Lỗi hay mắc: “address to the problem” (thừa to).

column1:
draw a conclusion
Collocation · neutral–formal

Don't jump to conclusions — maybe she's just busy.
column2:
rút ra kết luận
to decide something is true based on information

Ngữ pháp: draw / reach / come to a conclusion (from + N). Không dùng “take a conclusion”. jump to conclusions = vội kết luận.
Kết hợp: draw conclusions from the data · draw the conclusion that · jump to conclusions
Ví dụ:
• Don't jump to conclusions — maybe she's just busy.
• It's too early to draw any conclusions from one failed run.
• From this evidence, we can draw the conclusion that diet affects mood.
Lỗi hay mắc: “take/make a conclusion”.

column1:
take responsibility (for)
Collocation · neutral

You broke it, so take responsibility for it.
column2:
nhận trách nhiệm (về)
to accept that you are responsible for something

Ngữ pháp: take (full) responsibility for + N/V-ing. Không dùng “take responsible”. Responsibility là danh từ không đếm được trong cụm này.
Kết hợp: take full responsibility for · take responsibility for your actions · take on responsibility
Ví dụ:
• You broke it, so take responsibility for it.
• I take full responsibility for the missed test case.
• Parents should take responsibility for their children's screen time.
Lỗi hay mắc: “take responsibility of” (đúng: for); “take the responsibility” khi không xác định.

column1:
as far as I know
Fixed Expression · neutral

As far as I know, the store's open until ten.
column2:
theo tôi biết thì
based on the information I have (I might be wrong)

Ngữ pháp: Đứng đầu hoặc cuối câu: As far as I know, + clause / …, as far as I know. Phủ định ngắn: Not as far as I know.
Kết hợp: as far as I know · not as far as I know · as far as I can tell
Ví dụ:
• As far as I know, the store's open until ten.
• As far as I know, that bug was fixed in the last sprint.
• As far as I know, most universities in Vietnam now offer online courses.
Lỗi hay mắc: “As far as I knew” khi nói về hiện tại; “As long as I know” (sai cụm).

column1:
that being said / having said that
Fixed Expression · neutral

The food was great. That being said, it was way too expensive.
column2:
nói vậy chứ…, dù vậy…
despite what I have just said

Ngữ pháp: Đứng đầu câu, có dấu phẩy: That being said, … / Having said that, … (mệnh đề phân từ rút gọn). Có thể đứng sau “But”.
Kết hợp: that being said, · having said that, · with that being said
Ví dụ:
• The food was great. That being said, it was way too expensive.
• The release is stable. Having said that, we still need to monitor error rates.
• Technology has many benefits. That being said, it can also isolate people.
Lỗi hay mắc: “That been said”, “Have said that”.

column1:
it turns out (that)
Fixed Expression · neutral

It turns out he's been married this whole time!
column2:
hóa ra là
used when you discover something surprising

Ngữ pháp: It turns out (that) + clause / It turned out to be + N. Cũng có: As it turns out, …
Kết hợp: it turns out that · as it turned out · turned out to be
Ví dụ:
• It turns out he's been married this whole time!
• It turned out the test was failing because of a time zone issue.
• It turns out that children who read for pleasure do better at school.
Lỗi hay mắc: “It is turned out”; “It turns out to that”.

column1:
I wouldn't go that far.
Fixed Expression · neutral

“That movie was the worst ever.” “I wouldn't go that far.”
column2:
tôi không đến mức nói vậy
I partly agree, but your statement is too strong

Ngữ pháp: I wouldn't go that far (as to say…). Would = giả định lịch sự.
Kết hợp: I wouldn't go that far · I wouldn't go so far as to say…
Ví dụ:
• “That movie was the worst ever.” “I wouldn't go that far.”
• It's slow, but I wouldn't go that far as to call it broken.
• “Social media destroys friendships?” I wouldn't go that far.
Lỗi hay mắc: “I won't go that far” (nghe như từ chối đi xa thật).

column1:
at the end of the day
Fixed Expression · informal–neutral

At the end of the day, it's your money.
column2:
rốt cuộc thì, suy cho cùng
when everything is considered

Ngữ pháp: Đứng đầu câu: At the end of the day, + clause. Nghĩa đen (cuối ngày) cũng dùng — dựa ngữ cảnh. Dùng vừa phải, lạm dụng nghe sáo.
Kết hợp: at the end of the day, it's…
Ví dụ:
• At the end of the day, it's your money.
• At the end of the day, users only care whether it works.
• At the end of the day, education is an investment in the future.
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng trong IELTS Writing (nên thay: ultimately).

column1:
a piece of cake
Idiom · informal

The driving test was a piece of cake.
column2:
dễ như ăn bánh
very easy

Ngữ pháp: be + a piece of cake; luôn có “a”.
Kết hợp: a piece of cake for sb
Ví dụ:
• The driving test was a piece of cake.
• Writing that test script was a piece of cake.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: Bỏ “a”: “It's piece of cake”.

column1:
under the weather
Idiom · informal

I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
column2:
hơi mệt, khó ở
slightly ill

Ngữ pháp: feel / be + under the weather.
Kết hợp: feel a bit under the weather
Ví dụ:
• I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
• I'm a bit under the weather, so I'll join the stand-up remotely.
• I was under the weather on the day of my exam, which affected my score.
Lỗi hay mắc: Nói “under weather” (thiếu the).

column1:
call it a day
Idiom · informal

It's late — let's call it a day.
column2:
nghỉ thôi, kết thúc công việc hôm nay
to stop working for now

Ngữ pháp: Let's call it a day. Biến thể tối: call it a night.
Kết hợp: let's call it a day · call it a night
Ví dụ:
• It's late — let's call it a day.
• We've fixed the blockers; let's call it a day and pick this up tomorrow.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “call it the day”.

column1:
once in a blue moon
Idiom · informal

I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
column2:
hiếm khi, năm thì mười họa
very rarely

Ngữ pháp: Đứng cuối câu: do sth once in a blue moon.
Kết hợp: only once in a blue moon
Ví dụ:
• I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
• We only touch that legacy module once in a blue moon.
• I go to the cinema once in a blue moon because tickets are expensive.
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng “one time in a blue moon”.

column1:
in the same boat
Idiom · neutral

Don't worry, we're all in the same boat.
column2:
cùng cảnh ngộ
in the same difficult situation

Ngữ pháp: be in the same boat (as sb).
Kết hợp: we're all in the same boat
Ví dụ:
• Don't worry, we're all in the same boat.
• Every team is in the same boat with these budget cuts.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “on the same boat”.

column1:
hit the sack
Idiom · informal

I'm exhausted, I'm going to hit the sack.
column2:
đi ngủ
to go to bed

Ngữ pháp: hit the sack / hit the hay.
Kết hợp: time to hit the sack
Ví dụ:
• I'm exhausted, I'm going to hit the sack.
• -
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng trong văn trang trọng.

column1:
make ends meet
Idiom · neutral

With two kids, it's hard to make ends meet.
column2:
xoay xở đủ sống
to earn just enough money to live

Ngữ pháp: make ends meet; thường với struggle to / barely.
Kết hợp: struggle to make ends meet · barely make ends meet
Ví dụ:
• With two kids, it's hard to make ends meet.
• Many contractors struggle to make ends meet between projects.
• Many families in big cities struggle to make ends meet.
Lỗi hay mắc: “make the ends meet”.

column1:
cost an arm and a leg
Idiom · informal

That car must have cost an arm and a leg.
column2:
đắt cắt cổ
to be very expensive

Ngữ pháp: sth costs an arm and a leg.
Kết hợp: cost (sb) an arm and a leg
Ví dụ:
• That car must have cost an arm and a leg.
• Enterprise licenses cost an arm and a leg.
• Living in the city centre costs an arm and a leg.
Lỗi hay mắc: “cost an arm and leg”.

column1:
the last straw
Idiom · neutral

When he lied again, that was the last straw.
column2:
giọt nước tràn ly
the final problem that makes you lose patience

Ngữ pháp: be the last straw / the final straw.
Kết hợp: that was the last straw
Ví dụ:
• When he lied again, that was the last straw.
• The third outage this week was the last straw for the client.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “the last drop” (dịch từ tiếng Việt).

column1:
spill the beans
Idiom · informal

Come on, spill the beans! Who is she?
column2:
lộ bí mật
to reveal a secret

Ngữ pháp: spill the beans (about sth).
Kết hợp: spill the beans about
Ví dụ:
• Come on, spill the beans! Who is she?
• Someone spilled the beans about the reorg before HR announced it.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “spill the bean”.

column1:
let the cat out of the bag
Idiom · informal

Who let the cat out of the bag about the party?
column2:
lỡ miệng để lộ bí mật
to accidentally reveal a secret

Ngữ pháp: let the cat out of the bag (about sth).
Kết hợp:
Ví dụ:
• Who let the cat out of the bag about the party?
• Don't let the cat out of the bag — the launch is confidential.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng cho việc cố ý tiết lộ (nên dùng spill the beans).

column1:
break the ice
Idiom · neutral

A joke is a great way to break the ice.
column2:
phá băng, làm không khí bớt ngại
to make people feel more relaxed at first meeting

Ngữ pháp: break the ice (with sb); danh từ: an icebreaker.
Kết hợp: break the ice with a joke · an icebreaker game
Ví dụ:
• A joke is a great way to break the ice.
• We started the workshop with a quick game to break the ice.
• Talking about the weather helps strangers break the ice.
Lỗi hay mắc: “break ice” thiếu the.

column1:
on the tip of my tongue
Idiom · neutral

His name is on the tip of my tongue.
column2:
ở ngay đầu lưỡi (nhớ mà chưa nói ra được)
almost remembered

Ngữ pháp: be on the tip of my/your tongue.
Kết hợp:
Ví dụ:
• His name is on the tip of my tongue.
• The config flag is on the tip of my tongue — give me a sec.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “in the tip of my tongue”.

column1:
sleep on it
Idiom · neutral

It's a big decision — let me sleep on it.
column2:
để ngủ một đêm rồi quyết
to wait until tomorrow to decide

Ngữ pháp: Let me sleep on it.
Kết hợp: let me sleep on it
Ví dụ:
• It's a big decision — let me sleep on it.
• The offer looks good; I'll sleep on it and reply tomorrow.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “sleep over it”.

column1:
take a rain check
Idiom · informal

Can I take a rain check on drinks tonight?
column2:
hẹn dịp khác
to decline now but accept later

Ngữ pháp: take a rain check (on sth); Can I take a rain check?
Kết hợp: take a rain check on dinner
Ví dụ:
• Can I take a rain check on drinks tonight?
• I'll take a rain check on the team lunch — I'm on call.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: Dùng nghĩa đen về mưa.

column1:
my two cents
Idiom · informal

Just my two cents, but I'd buy the blue one.
column2:
ý kiến nhỏ của tôi
my opinion

Ngữ pháp: That's my two cents; put/throw in my two cents.
Kết hợp: just my two cents · add my two cents
Ví dụ:
• Just my two cents, but I'd buy the blue one.
• If I can add my two cents, we should automate the smoke tests first.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “my two coins”.

column1:
it's not rocket science
Idiom · informal

Just follow the recipe — it's not rocket science.
column2:
đâu có cao siêu gì
it's not difficult

Ngữ pháp: It's not rocket science; biến thể: It's not brain surgery.
Kết hợp:
Ví dụ:
• Just follow the recipe — it's not rocket science.
• Writing a basic API test isn't rocket science.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc:

column1:
hang in there
Idiom · informal

Hang in there — it's almost the weekend.
column2:
cố lên, ráng chịu
keep going in a difficult time

Ngữ pháp: Hang in there! (câu mệnh lệnh).
Kết hợp:
Ví dụ:
• Hang in there — it's almost the weekend.
• Hang in there, the release is almost done.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc:

column1:
cut to the chase
Idiom · informal

Let's cut to the chase — how much do you want?
column2:
vào thẳng vấn đề
to talk about the important part immediately

Ngữ pháp: Let's cut to the chase.
Kết hợp: let's cut to the chase
Ví dụ:
• Let's cut to the chase — how much do you want?
• I'll cut to the chase: we're two weeks behind.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “cut the chase”.

column1:
beat around the bush
Idiom · neutral

Stop beating around the bush and tell me.
column2:
vòng vo tam quốc
to avoid saying something directly

Ngữ pháp: beat around the bush (Anh-Anh: beat about the bush); hay ở phủ định.
Kết hợp: stop beating around the bush
Ví dụ:
• Stop beating around the bush and tell me.
• I won't beat around the bush — the project is cancelled.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “beat around the bushes”.

column1:
the ball is in your court
Idiom · neutral

I've apologized. The ball is in her court now.
column2:
giờ đến lượt bạn quyết
it is your turn to act

Ngữ pháp: The ball is in your/their court.
Kết hợp:
Ví dụ:
• I've apologized. The ball is in her court now.
• We've sent the proposal; the ball is in the client's court.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “the ball is on your court”.

column1:
by the book
Idiom · neutral

My dad does everything by the book.
column2:
đúng quy định, theo sách
strictly following the rules

Ngữ pháp: do sth / go by the book.
Kết hợp: do it by the book · go by the book
Ví dụ:
• My dad does everything by the book.
• For audits, we have to do everything by the book.
• -
Lỗi hay mắc: “by book”.

column1:
back to the drawing board
Idiom · neutral

The recipe failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
column2:
làm lại kế hoạch từ đầu
